dedupeRules: Same Git blob across branches counts once.
Same provider session counter prefix contributes its maximum confirmed completed suffix, never the sum of snapshots.
Explicitly derived local evaluations/component replay add zero official rounds.
New current-session rounds must remain distinct and should expose any overshoot after historical evidence was available.
These are evidence lower bounds, not a claim that the provider private math or full parity is verified.
